sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Good health speeds up the recovery from the damage sustained in the raids, decreases the probability of fractures and lowers the energy and dehydration rate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - It is unknown what function the elite effect "damage absorption" is supposed to have. There is no indication or evidence of it reducing any incoming damage.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 4 of this skill is needed for the quest Health Care Privacy - Part 4

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text: - Level 2 of this skill is needed for the Medstation level 2

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces limb fracture chance (1.2% per level → -60% at Elite Level)
- Reduces energy consumption (0.6% per level → -30% at Elite Level)
- Reduces dehydration rate (0.6% per level → -30% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Damage absorption

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Every time skill points are gained for Endurance, Strength or Vitality, 25% of the amount is gained for this skill.
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest Beneath The Streets
